text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
--- A new bill making it possible to evict biker gangs from premises in residential areas could be ready for its first reading by the end of the day.

--- Danish researchers have drafted a risk profile for diabetics which identifies sufferers who risk an early death and thus increases chances of saving them . The profile has been made after 10 years' studies of more than 900 insulin users.

--- Post Danmark, is to start cooperation with postal services in nine other European countries in the spring of 1997 in an attempt to win back part of the market for international consignments from large private courier firms like the international DHL.

--- New car dealers now fear that the new rules on car taxes which were introduced on October 1 will start a price war. Denmark's car dealer association (D.A.F) has summoned 900 of its members to a conference where it will urge on members to not challenge each other with low car prices.

--- Train factory Adtranz Danmark A/S which lost the fight to win the order for trains for the new subway in Copehagen now hopes to win an order worth 1.5 billion crowns for trains for Germany and Belgium.
